name: kalamalah-player
description: Kalamalah Quran Player & Reader with Hybrid SSR Prerendering, Mushaf Pages, and Word-by-Word Ayah Sync

scripts.build:client: bun build src/client/app.ts --outdir public/js --target browser --format esm --splitting --minify --entry-naming '[name]-[hash].[ext]' --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext]'
scripts.build:manifest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const jsDir='public/js'; const files=fs.readdirSync(jsDir); const app=files.find(f=>f.startsWith('app-')&&f.endsWith('.js')); let chunks=[]; const chunksDir=path.join(jsDir,'chunks'); if(fs.existsSync(chunksDir)){chunks=fs.readdirSync(chunksDir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>'/js/chunks/'+f);} fs.writeFileSync('public/js/manifest.json', JSON.stringify({app:'/js/'+app,chunks}, null, 2));"
scripts.build:static: bun run build:client && bun run build:manifest && bun run src/server/static-export.ts
